name: Gender, Sexuality, and Women's Studies (Humanities)
notes: The Susan B. Anthony Institute offers TWO GSWS majors - one in the humanities and one in the social sciences. This entry is the HUMANITIES major; the social-sciences major is a separate entry (major-gsws-ss-ba). They differ only in which track the core courses and electives must come from.
To complete a major, a student must take 10 courses (40 credits) in GSWS. Students may use up to 4 courses taken abroad.

Core courses used for the major must NOT be the required courses: 'If you are completing a minor or major, you must take core courses that are not the required courses (GSWS 105, GSWS 200).' GSWS 105 and GSWS 200 are therefore excluded from the core groups below.
GSWS 100 (Topics in GSW) changes topic by semester and its humanities/social-science designation changes with it. Students may only take GSWS 100 once.

TRACK DESIGNATION NOT ENFORCEABLE for the three free GSWS courses: the catalog does not record an H or SS designation per course, so the elective group accepts any GSWS course. Check each course's current designation with SBAI - see the master course list.

HONORS: students may replace GSWS 393 with GSWS 389H (fall) plus GSWS 393H (spring) and write a roughly 35-page honors thesis; honors requires a GSWS GPA of at least 3.3. Honors students take 11 courses rather than 10.
DEGREE DISTINCTIONS (not tracked by the planner): a GSWS major GPA of at least 3.4 graduates with Distinction, 3.6 High Distinction, 3.8 Highest Distinction.
